outcome: branch (a) cloning helps and no penalty remains: the freshly drawn expert IS the residual mechanism - a grown expert should start as a twin, and section 5.22's two-stage delivery is qualified again
summary_note: Section 5.26. R and C are the same seed, initial model and data schedule, every event forced to a grow, differing only in whether a grown expert starts freshly drawn or as a clone of the layer's busiest survivor (body and router row). R_own and C_own are the frozen retrains of each fused run's own final genome, so R_own-R and C_own-C are the two penalties. The forced operation makes both settings choose the same layer, so the final genomes are identical and C_own == R_own exactly - both checked in built_in_checks, not assumed. Negative means the first-named run won.
